title: Dynamics 365 consulting services across eight areas
description: MP-365 helps mid-size and enterprise teams get more from Dynamics 365, Microsoft 365 and Copilot, with faster decisions, cleaner data and less manual work.

tabs.label: Build
tabs.description: Dynamics 365 Sales, Customer Service and Customer Insights, plus integrations that connect the CRM to ERP and other systems. Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI and custom Copilot agents build on the Microsoft data you already have.

proof.quote: Faster, smoother Dynamics deployments, with manual errors reduced to near zero.
proof.author: OTIS Elevator, platform and operations leadership for Dynamics

tabs.label: Migrate
tabs.description: Exchange and OneDrive moves into Microsoft 365, SharePoint Server upgrades and file share migrations, and tenant to tenant migration for mergers, acquisitions and divestitures.

proof.quote: SharePoint 2007, 2010, 2013 and 2016 moved to Microsoft 365 in stages, and file shares moved into organized libraries with metadata and version control.
proof.author: MP-365 client projects

tabs.label: Govern
tabs.description: Permission models, Microsoft Purview and CRM data quality, so people see only what they should. Legacy applications move to Azure with safer, automated releases for Dynamics 365 and Power Platform.

proof.quote: CRM access control with an approval process, documented access levels and automatic access reports.
proof.author: MP-365 client project
